arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Goldstein argued American Pipe tolling applies to both limits.
Clement argued the three-year limit is a statute of repose.
Roberts questioned whether a relative price drop bars suits.
Kagan asked if the distinction is practical or formal.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: The case tests whether the three-year repose limit in the Securities Act pauses during a class action. the sides that brought the case say it pauses. the opposing sides say it does not.
